scenario: Duration literals per LGRA.15.7: an integer and a unit, one token, with no compound, fractional or negative form. Minutes are `min`; `m` is meters (LGRA.2.8.9). A rule with `then B within 30_s` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` does not read the lowered 30_000_000_000 ns.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

schema B scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

rule r:
    A
    then B within 30_s
->
    log info "x"
